endorsements.name: Zaid Shaikh
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-0202
endorsements.description: A vulnerability was found in TCS BaNCS 10. It has been classified as problematic. This affects an unknown part of the file /REPORTS/REPORTS_SHOW_FILE.jsp. The manipulation of the argument FilePath leads to file inclusion. The real existence of this vulnerability is still doubted at the moment.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.5)

endorsements.name: Zaid Shaikh
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-1836
endorsements.description: A vulnerability was found in Incorta 2023.4.3. It has been classified as problematic. Affected is an unknown function of the component Edit Insight Handler. The manipulation of the argument Service Name leads to csv injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 4.0, 5.3)
